title: Ideologies
source: FINDINGS-definitions.md: CIdeologyGroup::LoadKey (0x126E60: `faction`, `position`, every other key an ideology), CIdeology::LoadKey (0x126B80: `color`), CFaction::LoadKey (0x1227E0); CIdeology : CModifier and CFactionModifier : CModifier (class hierarchy)

file.desc: each key is an ideology group (loader 0x527470, not read)

group.desc: an ideology group: `faction`, `position`, and every other key an ideology

faction.desc: the faction this group's countries join

position.desc: where the faction sits on the diplomacy triangle

ideology.desc: an ideology: `color`, then falls through to CModifier::LoadKey for any other key - a modifier kind; which names that takes is not read, so an unknown one is reported softly

faction.desc: a faction. The keys are CFaction::LoadKey's eight (0x1227E0), and the six the files use are all among them - but that this block is read by that loader is inference from the match, not a reading

tag.desc: the faction's name, which `faction = ...` elsewhere names

influence.desc: the modifier kind that pulls countries towards it - `align_towards_axis` and the like

country.desc: save state: a member, as a savegame writes it

progress.desc: save state, as a savegame writes it

faction_modifier.desc: the faction's modifier (CFactionModifier, which reads with CModifier::LoadKey)

rule.desc: rules by name = yes: `limited_war`, `allience_wide_guarantee`, `free_resource_gifts` are what the game and the mod use; the loader was not read

position.desc: a point on the triangle. CMapPoint::LoadKey (0x5D2A0) takes exactly `x` and `y` and drops anything else; that this block is a CMapPoint is inference
